verdict.rationale: Retell AI is an AI voice-agent platform, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented policy or setting that excludes customer data from model training. The per-agent data retention and auto-deletion feature is an adjacent control: it limits how long data is stored, not whether it is used for training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
